stem: A writer argues that because page 20 contains detailed obesity material, the same PDF likely contains detailed BRUE and SIDS material elsewhere, so drafting those items is acceptable; what is the best critique of this argument?

options.text: It is valid because likely content elsewhere in the same PDF can be treated as retrieved
It is invalid because only the supplied excerpts, not presumed unretrieved pages, can ground examinable claims
It is valid if the answer choices are broad and non-specific
It is valid in Australian paediatrics but not internationally
It is invalid only if the question mentions investigations

explanation: Presumed unretrieved pages cannot be used to support examinable claims. Only the supplied excerpts count as available evidence, so inferring detailed BRUE or SIDS content from another page in the same PDF is not a valid basis for drafting.
